ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Companies Law, Cap. 113 (as amended); The Prevention and Suppression of Money Laundering Activities Law, L.188(I)/2007, as amended by the Anti-Money Laundering and Combatting Terrorist Financing Law amendments (including L.13(I)/2020 and subsequent transposition of EU AMLD5/AMLD6); Cyprus Registrar of Companies (DRCORP) UBO filing obligations; EU sanctions implementing regulations and national anti-money laundering directives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport or national identity document of each beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport or civil registry authority in the country of citizenship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (1961 Convention) if the issuing country is an Apostille Party; otherwise consular legalization through the responsible embassy/consulate followed by acceptance by Cypriot authorities

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address for each beneficial owner and director (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or issuing bank in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization; bank-statement signatures must be notarized if the document is not already formalized

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or current company register extract for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or official corporate register in the jurisdiction of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization of the underlying corporate registry certificate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter from the existing banker of each shareholder or director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank officer signature notarized and then Hague Apostille or consular legalization if the bank letter originates outside Cyprus

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the Cyprus incorporation agent and filing officers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution by each shareholder/director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization; the signed POA must be certified as true and current at the time of filing

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers and signatories against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, OFAC SDN, UN Security Council sanctions (including UN 1267/1989/1988 regimes) and Cyprus national designations. PEP and family/close associates screening required under FATF Recommendation 12 and Cyprus AML law L.188(I)/2007. For this Medium_Risk_Enhanced pure equity holding SPV, enhanced due diligence applies to the ultimate ownership chain, documentary source of funds for any dividend flow, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Transactions involving a PEP UBO require senior management approval and enhanced ongoing monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCORP) - Electronic Companies Portal / Ariadne e-filing system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be registered in Greek and/or Roman characters. If the name is registered in Greek, a Latin-script transliteration must be recorded. The name must end in 'Limited' or 'ΛΙΜΙΤΕΔ' for a private limited company, must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, and must not create a false impression of connection with government, regulators, royal or ministerial authority, or restricted regulated professions.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension of a name reservation may be requested from DRCORP before the initial reservation expires. If the name is rejected, the applicant may file a fresh application with an alternative name, or submit a written reconsideration request to the Registrar. If the rejection is upheld, an administrative judicial-review recourse may be brought under Article 146 of the Cyprus Constitution before the Administrative Court within 75 days of notification of the refusal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Cyprus law requires a registered office address in Cyprus at all times. For an ISIC 6420 pure equity holding SPV, a virtual office address or registered-agent address can satisfy the strict statutory minimum in some administrative contexts, but it is not sufficient to establish Cyprus tax residence or treaty eligibility under the management-and-control test. A purely passive equity-holding SPV should have a real physical registered office in Cyprus, substantive local administrative records, and a credible local management structure. A licensed CySEC entity cannot rely on a virtual office. For this unlicensed holding SPV, virtual office is permissible only as a temporary/administrative accommodation and will heighten AML and tax-substance review.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium risk tier: approximately 5-15% annual probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection for a passive unlicensed holding SPV. The probability rises to 15-30% where the SPV claims tax-treaty relief, receives high-value dividends, or has a PEP or high-risk ownership profile.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law, Cap. 113 of the Laws of Cyprus (as amended); sections 3–16 (incorporation), 17–22 (constitution), 112–115 (register of members), 170–172 (registration procedures).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRC), Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry, Republic of Cyprus.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association; accompanying Form HE1 (Declaration of Compliance) and Form HE2 (Notice of Registered Office).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Cyprus law. The company may incorporate with a nominal subscribed share capital of at least EUR 1.00. There is no statutory escrow or capital verification requirement; subscribed capital may be deposited in the company's Cyprus corporate bank account upon incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers' agreement and share subscription list be and are hereby ratified and approved; that the subscriber hereby subscribes to, and is allotted, ordinary shares of EUR 1.00 each in the capital of the Company, as recorded in the register of members. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be at [Address, Cyprus] and that the company be authorised to open bank accounts with [Bank] for deposit of subscribed capital. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name] be and is hereby appointed as first director, and [Name] as company secretary, each to hold office until alternation in accordance with the Articles of Association.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRC) online portal / e-Filing window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through the DRC portal or in-person counter. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name and must not contain restricted words unless prior approval is obtained. The applicant may select up to three alternative names in order of preference.
required_dossiers: Company name reservation application
Passport copies of the subscriber(s)
Authorization letter appointing the local registered agent
Written consent of any relevant authority if a restricted word is used
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, resubmit with alternative names, supply a formal written consent from the conflicting company, or file an objection under DRC practice directions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Cyprus advocate or certified public accountant acting as registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English or Greek. The incorporators must execute the document in the presence of a notary public or independent witness who certifies the signatures. The constitutional deed must state the company object as passive holding of subsidiary shares under ISIC 6420 and clause limit liabilities of members to the amount unpaid on their shares.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association
Form HE1 Declaration of Compliance
Identity documents of subscribers
Proof of registered agent licensing
Certified translation of any non-Greek or non-English supporting documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any drafting deficiencies in the objects clause or share rights provisions and re-execute the instrument before a notary public, then resubmit the corrected version to the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open corporate bank account and deposit subscribed capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Cyprus operating in the Republic of Cyprus.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the corporate service provider to open a corporate bank account in the company's intended name. Complete bank application forms, provide due diligence information, and deposit at least the nominal subscribed capital into the account. The bank will issue a deposit confirmation or a letter acknowledging the available corporate balance.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copies of directors and shareholders
Source of funds declarations for the subscribers
Bank reference for the ultimate beneficial owner
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certified proof of address of directors and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises documentary queries, provide a structured corporate ownership chart, audited financial statements of the ultimate parent, or enhanced due diligence responses and resubmit the application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File incorporation documents and obtain Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRC), Nicosia headquarters or recognised e-filing portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, Form HE1, Form HE2, and the prescribed registration fee to the DRC. The DRC verifies the statutory requirements and issues a Certificate of Incorporation under section 7 of the Companies Law.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Form HE1 Declaration of Compliance
Form HE2 Notice of Registered Office
Certificate of appointment of registered agent
Filing fee remittance proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DRC issues a query or requisition, respond through the registered agent within 14 days; amend the memorandum or articles if requested, and pay any revised registration fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register with tax and social insurance authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cyprus Tax Department (Corporate Income Tax Division) and Social Insurance Services (SIS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 60 days of incorporation, file the income tax registration application and obtain a Tax Identification Code (TIC). Where the company’s activities are limited to holding investments and receiving dividends, VAT registration is not mandatory unless taxable supplies are made. Register with SIS for employer obligations if the company will hire employees.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Certified Memorandum and Articles of Association
Directors' and shareholders' identity documents
Registered office address confirmation
Bank account details of the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Tax Department delays registration, submit a written explanation, pay any applicable late filing penalty, and request acceleration of the TIC issuance through the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt statutory corporate governance records and issue shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office of the company and the company secretary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or adopt unanimous written resolutions. Pass the board resolution for allotment of shares, adoption of registered office, appointment of officers, and opening of bank accounts. Issue share certificates and establish the statutory registers, including the register of members, register of directors and secretaries, and minutes of board meetings.
required_dossiers: First board meeting minutes or written resolution
Share certificates
Register of members
Register of directors and secretaries
Registered office records and statutory forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any recording mistakes in the statutory books and, if required by the Registrar, file amended returns and pay the prescribed late filing penalty.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for a passive equity holding SPV under ISIC 6420; no industrial manufacturing or trading registration is required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Environment of the Republic of Cyprus
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no physical works, industrial installation, or operational development arising from the pure equity holding activity
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; the company generates no wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or waste streams. If only administrative office use exists, waste handling must follow municipal solid waste collection regulations and any applicable office recycling obligations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office premises require a Fire Safety Compliance Certificate issued by the Cyprus Fire Service following an inspection, a valid structural occupancy permit from the local municipality, and periodic maintenance of fire extinguishers. No industrial workplace clearance is required for a passive holding company.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Cyprus (Κεντρική Τράπεζα της Κύπρου), operating within the European System of Central Banks and subject to the monetary policy and supervisory framework of the European Central Bank
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Cyprus is a fully euroised jurisdiction. The euro is freely convertible for both capital and current account transactions. No exchange control restrictions apply to cross-border transfers to EU/EEA recipients, and only limited monitoring obligations apply to extra-EU payments under EU free-capital-movement rules. Profit remittances can be distributed as dividends without any foreign-exchange authorisation, subject only to Cyprus corporate formalities and beneficial 0% domestic withholding tax under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive. Banks may apply internal anti-money-laundering screening, but no governmental conversion or approval requirement exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender rule exists in Cyprus. Exporters may retain export receipts in any convertible currency, and there is no mandatory conversion ratio or repatriation timeline. All proceeds must be properly recorded in corporate books and accepted for tax purposes in accordance with ordinary Greek accounting standards. Transfer pricing and thin capitalisation rules remain applicable; no certificate of surrender is required by the Central Bank of Cyprus.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. Cyprus permits locally authorised Electronic Money Institutions and EU passporting under the E-Money Directive, but offshore digital EMIs without a Cyprus licence cannot provide settlement or cleared rails for capital injections, dividend flows, or intercompany debt in a manner acceptable to tier-1 financial institutions. EMIs may be used for small operational payments, but for this pure equity holding SPV, SWIFT-capable commercial banks are operationally and regulatory required as the primary treasury rail. Legal constraints include AML transaction thresholds, restrictions on correspondent banking, and elevated verification burdens for non-EU EMI counterparties.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The Central Bank of Cyprus and the Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission impose a risk-based due diligence mandate under L.188(I)/2007. In-person KYC interview is mandatory for ultimate beneficial owners, directors, and authorised signatories unless the entity is onboarded through an EU/EEA regulated institution acting as a trusted introducer under passporting provisions. In practice, at least one physical appearance by the ultimate beneficial owner and a local authorised signatory for medium-risk holding structures is universally required. Remote video interviews may support enhanced due diligence but do not replace the physical initial meeting where any red flag is present. Companies without local substance must appoint physically resident directors or an external Cyprus corporate service provider authorised with a formal power of attorney.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO and ownership opacity: bearer shares, nominee shareholders, or multi-tier offshore holding chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete updated share register under Cyprus Companies Law, UBO Declaration Form (N1340 / intercompany registry) identifying all ultimate natural persons, certified passports and proof of residential address, full corporate organisational chart tracing each intermediate entity, trust deed and trustee register if applicable, and board resolution approving the ownership structure

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds: inbound equity injection from a jurisdiction lacking clear tax residence or involving a politically exposed person (PEP)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank reference letter from the remitting institution, audited financial statements of the funding entity, tax residence certificates of all direct and ultimate shareholders, signed share subscription agreement and contribution declaration, sworn source-of-wealth statement, and bank statements evidencing the transaction trail

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction pattern mismatch: equity holding SPV conducts frequent trade settlement or payments to high-risk third countries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed treasury business plan, board-approved investment mandate, underlying share purchase and cooperation contracts, supporting invoices, legal opinion from Cyprus counsel, and a full purpose-code narrative for each SWIFT field 70 remittance instruction

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of economic substance: registered office only, no local directors, no local employees, no actual operational footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tenancy and lease agreement for the Cyprus registered office, local director appointment deeds and consent letters, outsourced corporate administration agreements with a licensed service provider, and an economic substance file demonstrating compliance with Cyprus, EU, and OECD requirements, including projected payroll and local management activity

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all inbound capital injections using SWIFT MT103 (or TARGET2 for euro transfers) to the Cyprus IBAN with the exact corporate legal name as beneficiary. Use ISO 20022 purpose code 'EQUI' where offered, otherwise the EPC remittance narrative 'Shareholder equity injection under Investment Agreement dated [date]'. Provide concurrently to the remitting bank a certified board resolution affirming the contribution, a signed deed of contribution or share subscription agreement, and a statement of no adverse encumbrance. For extra-EU payments, include full correspondent banking details and complete legal address of the beneficial owner. Ensure the ultimate funding party's bank applies standard AML verification and the Cyprus receiving bank obtains the remitter's passport and financial statements for funds-above-EUR-50,000.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operational disbursements and downstream investments, use SWIFT MT103 for direct settlement. For trade needs, use Documentary Letters of Credit (MP700) where the underlying flow is commercial and collateralised. For dividends and intercompany loans, SWIFT MT103 with ISO 20022 purpose codes 'DIVD' (dividend), 'INTC' (intercompany payment), or 'LOAN' (repayment of principal), accompanied by board minutes and intercompany agreements. Euro-clearing flows settle via TARGET2/SEPA infrastructure for amounts under EUR 100,000; larger amounts and all cross-currency flows use correspondent banks in London or New York via CHAPS/CHIPS.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable FX forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP) under ISDA or FRFTA master agreements with Cyprus authorised credit institutions
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for emerging-market currencies without deliverable offshore markets, limited to bona fide balance-sheet and cash-flow hedging
FX swaps (spot-near/forward-far) for efficient currency conversion and temporary liquidity bridging
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for long-term hedge of foreign-currency intercompany funding

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Company Levy (Companies Law, Cap. 113, Section 86 as amended)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCOR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of €30 if paid by August 31; additional €60 if paid by November 30; unpaid levy by December 31 triggers administrative strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form HE32) with particulars of shareholders, directors, secretary, registered office, and share capital
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCOR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days of each annual return date (anniversary of incorporation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Graduated default fines: €10 (≤1 month late), €20 (1-3 months), €40 (3-6 months), €60 (6-12 months), €100 (>12 months); prolonged non-compliance risks administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited financial statements in IFRS (filed concurrently with the Annual Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCOR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months of the financial year end (December 31 for a calendar-year SPV)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default fines assessed under Cap. 113; failure to lodge audited accounts constitutes a register-default and may lead to administrative strike-off and director penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Tax Return (Form TD4) with audited financial statements annexed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: December 31 of the year following the tax year (e.g., FY 2024 return due by December 31, 2025)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: €100 administrative fine for late filing; 10% surcharge on any tax due and statutory default interest on unpaid amounts; criminal liability for failure to notify chargeability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBO Register declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (UBO Register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year; within 14 days of any change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal offense under L.188(I)/2007 as amended; fines up to €100 per non-compliance plus daily fine of €100; severe AML contraventions punishable by up to €500,000 and/or imprisonment.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Cyprus companies must appoint an independent auditor and have statutory accounts audited unless the small-company exemption in Section 37A of the Companies Law (Cap. 113) applies: meeting at least two of (a) balance-sheet total ≤ €350,000, (b) net turnover ≤ €700,000, (c) average employees ≤ 5. Exemption is unavailable to public-interest entities, financial institutions, holding companies of non-small groups, and subsidiaries within non-small groups; the pre-2021 gross-revenue threshold (≤ €70,000) is obsolete for financial years commencing after January 1, 2021.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as endorsed by the EU (EU-IFRS) for all companies required to prepare statutory financial statements; small companies may apply IFRS for SMEs. Financial statements must give a true and fair view and be audited by an ICPAC-approved statutory auditor.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Cyprus company must file and annually confirm its UBO declaration with the DRCOR UBO Register. Confirmation is due at least once per calendar year, and any UBO change—including share-transfer-driven changes—must be filed within 14 days. Before registration of any share transfer, the company must update the Register of Members, obtain board approval recorded in minutes, stamp the share transfer form, and file the revised UBO declaration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholders with share transfer details)
Minute Book (general meetings, board meetings, written resolutions)
Share certificate stubs and transfer ledger

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $1,100 - $2,800 (typical annual Cyprus registered-office and corporate-secretarial agent fees)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $2,200 - $5,500 (simple single-sector holding SPV; group audit engagements increase fees)
